A hand holds the raised section to begin lowering it.

The cabinet remains open while its propane compartment is surveyed.
The cabinet door is still open.
A hand is closing the cabinet using its vertical handle.

evidence.note: The grill shelf on the sliding-door side is folded down.

events.object_description: Foldable barbecue side shelf on the sliding-door side

evidence.note: The red-labeled shelf on the trellis side is folded against the grill.
A hand approaches the folded shelf to raise it.
The hand holds the shelf as it reaches its horizontal deployed position.

The shelf remains deployed horizontally.

notes: Five distinct manipulation episodes are visible. The close inspection of the propane cylinder while its cabinet is open does not show a separate valve-state change, so it is treated as part of the cabinet-door episode.
scene_description: A user surveys an apartment balcony, adjusts a white chaise lounge, and then operates four separate movable parts of a stainless-steel barbecue grill.
